orders_and_backlog.semantic: direct reported orders, bookings or backlog

conversion_and_durability.semantic: direct conversion, shipment durability or cancellation evidence

downstream_demand_context.semantic: bounded downstream demand read-through, not attributed purchasing

reported_results.semantic: observed current-period operating result, distinct from guidance

guidance_and_outlook.semantic: management guidance or forward outlook, distinct from reported result

pricing_and_mix.semantic: direct pricing, ASP or product-mix mechanism

margin_and_incremental_profit.semantic: direct margin or incremental-profit mechanism with stated limits

cash_generation.semantic: reported cash generation or conversion evidence

subject_execution.semantic: issuer-direct execution, component or delivery constraint

upstream_capacity_context.semantic: bounded upstream capacity, yield or allocation read-through

subject_relationship_disclosure.semantic: issuer-direct customer, supplier, commitment or concentration relationship

issuer_counterevidence.semantic: issuer-direct fact that weakens, limits or reverses the thesis

upstream_or_demand_counterevidence.semantic: upstream or downstream fact that weakens the thesis

issuer_policy_exposure.semantic: issuer-direct regulatory, export or compliance exposure

capital_allocation.semantic: reported capital allocation or net-debt action

point_in_time_valuation.semantic: point-in-time market and denominator input; narrative retrieval is not numeric authority
